# Chain model attribution

Source: **Chain** by Kutejnikov, OpenGameArt, 26 November 2020.
https://opengameart.org/content/chain
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

`chain.FBX` is the original model from the source archive. `ChainLink.fbx` is a
single link extracted, recentered, and resized in Blender for runtime tiling.
`Chain_BaseColor_512.png` is the source base-color texture resized from 2048 to
512 pixels. The material uses a Unity URP Lit shader. Include this attribution
and the license link with any distributed build that contains these assets.
